name: @pipeworx/mcp-securitytrails

tools.name: securitytrails_domain
tools.description: Domain intel (DNS, subdomain count) for <hostname>. Returns current A/MX/NS records, subdomain count, and Alexa rank. Example: securitytrails_domain({ hostname: "github.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: SecurityTrails API key (get one free at securitytrails.com — 50 lookups/mo)

tools.name: securitytrails_subdomains
tools.description: Enumerate subdomains of <hostname>. Returns the subdomain labels plus fully-qualified domains. Example: securitytrails_subdomains({ hostname: "github.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

hostname.description: Apex domain / hostname to enumerate, e.g. "github.com"

tools.name: securitytrails_dns_history
tools.description: Historical DNS records for <hostname>. Returns past record values with first/last-seen dates for a given record type (a, aaaa, mx, ns, soa, txt). Example: securitytrails_dns_history({ hostname: "github.com", type: "a", _apiKey: "your-key" })

type.description: DNS record type: a, aaaa, mx, ns, soa, or txt (default "a")

tools.name: securitytrails_whois
tools.description: WHOIS for <hostname>. Returns registrar, creation/expiration dates, and registration contacts. Example: securitytrails_whois({ hostname: "github.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-securitytrails forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the securitytrails pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
